text:
carla-ml: noticing a sharp throughput drop in pool-a at ~02:14 UTC. several workers restarted and we saw OOMs on 2x A100 nodes. latency from 80ms -> 600ms for small requests.

ben_h: @carla-ml seeing same in metrics, kv_cache eviction spikes and slab fragmentation increase. worker restarts correlate with kernel fallback logs.

dimitri: attaching profiler snapshot - looks like kernel_selector picked int8_fastpath for sequences <64 but we had a few 512s, that caused a big mem blowup when batch coalescer combined them.

alice: can you paste the kernel selection logs? also any hint the batcher increased max_batch_size?

carla-ml: logs:
```
[02:14:21] kernel_selector: chosen=int8_fastpath score=0.87
[02:14:21] batch_coalescer: combined batch sizes=[16,32,512] -> effective=560
[02:14:21] allocator: slab_alloc fail -> OOM, fallback to kernel=general
[02:14:22] worker: restart triggered
```

dimitri: exact issue: heuristics treat mixed seq lengths as small-sequence-optimal kernel, but coalescer didn't enforce homogeneity. int8_fastpath assumes uniform KV layout -> fragmentation when mixed.

ben_h: KV cache metrics: pre-incident hit-rate 0.78 -> drop to 0.22, eviction churn spiked. pages per slab increased 4x.

sre-jordan: rolling mitigation suggestions: 1) disable int8_fastpath kernel selection on pool-a 2) reduce coalescer merge window to 5ms 3) limit max combined batch token cap.

alice: prepared emergency rollout patch: kernel_heuristic.disable_fastpath=true

oncall-bot: Deploy started by alice at 02:46 UTC. CI green.

carla-ml: after patch: no new OOMs, latency back to ~90ms, throughput recovered to 85% of baseline. still seeing higher kv_evictions but stabilizing.

dimitri: follow-ups: add seq-length bucketing before coalescer, add explicit check in kernel_selector to refuse fastpath if mixed-seq batches detected, and add kv_cache-prefetch backoff when eviction rate > 5%.

ben_h: filing perf ticket and postmortem, will include flamegraphs and the profiler snapshot.

carla-ml: thanks everyone. leaving notes in the incident doc and will schedule a TTL for the fastpath heuristic to be re-enabled behind more robust checks :thumbsup:
